collision.policy: Existing deterministic simulation owns floor, bounds, pushes, jumps and hits. One flat ground at zero; no hazards, slopes, platforms or stage-created mechanics.

render.layerPolicy: Far painted capital and halo; independently placed fallen crowned head; real textured 3D floor and brass inlay; real recessed pier cores with transparent painted facades; ground contact shadows; fixed world-space combat canvas. Tick-driven presentation only.
render.foregroundPolicy: All upright architecture and rubble remain behind or outside the combat plane; fascia remains below the floor. Scenery cannot occlude active bodies or effects. Far backdrop tracks only enough to maintain camera overscan.

gotchas: This arena does not implement missing fighter mechanics or approve unfinished character animations.
Celeste is not yet selectable in the current V2 versus roster; Celeste-specific runtime checks await her integration.
Far city, statue and halo share one painted layer; floor, piers and near crowned head provide scene depth. This is a hybrid 2.5D arena, not a fully sculpted city.
